title: Diwali Skincare Routine: A Countdown Plan to 8 November
ex: A day-by-day Diwali skincare routine from now to 8 November, a festival-day plan around puja and make-up, and how to care for skin after crackers and smoke.
rt: Diwali Skincare Routine 2026: Countdown Plan | Mirc Glow
rd: Diwali skincare routine for 2026: a countdown to 8 November, festival-day steps, and gentle care for skin after crackers, smoke and late nights.
quick: Start a simple routine now: gentle cleanser, moisturiser, morning sunscreen and night cream, with no new products after about 25 October. Book any facial for 29 October to 1 November. After Diwali, double cleanse, moisturise and pause scrubs for a few days.
